title: Provident Fund
summary: EPF Provident Fund is Nepal's largest government-backed retirement savings scheme. Employee and employer each contribute 10% of basic salary monthly. Funds earn compound interest and are returned as lump sum at retirement.
nepaliSummary: कर्मचारी सञ्चय कोष नेपालको सबैभन्दा ठूलो सरकारी निवृत्तिभरण बचत योजना हो। कर्मचारी र नियोक्ता दुवैले मासिक आधार तलबको १०% योगदान गर्छन्। पैसा वार्षिक ब्याजसहित जम्मा हुन्छ र अवकाशमा एकमुष्ट फिर्ता हुन्छ।
eligibility: Must be a permanent employee (government or registered private sector)
Employer must be registered with EPF

title: Pension and Gratuity
summary: After completing qualifying service years, EPF members receive a monthly pension for life plus a one-time gratuity payment. Provides lifelong financial security after retirement.
nepaliSummary: निश्चित सेवा अवधि पूरा गरेपछि EPF सदस्यहरूले जीवनभर मासिक पेन्सन र एकपटक ग्रेच्युटी पाउँछन्। अवकाशपछि जीवनभर आर्थिक सुरक्षा दिने योजना हो।
eligibility: Must have reached retirement age (58 years)
Or voluntary retirement after 50 years of age with 20 years service

title: Special Loan
summary: EPF Special Loan allows members to borrow up to 90% of their accumulated provident fund balance for any personal purpose. Low interest rate compared to commercial banks with fund balance as collateral.
nepaliSummary: EPF विशेष सापटीले सदस्यहरूलाई आफ्नो जम्मा रकमको ९०% सम्म कुनै पनि व्यक्तिगत कामको लागि ऋण लिन दिन्छ। व्यावसायिक बैंकभन्दा कम ब्याजदरमा आफ्नै कोष धितो राखेर ऋण पाइन्छ।
eligibility: Active EPF member for minimum 1 year
No existing default on EPF loans
loanLimit: Up to 90% of accumulated provident fund balance

title: House Loan
summary: EPF House Loan enables members to purchase, construct, or buy a house using their EPF fund as collateral. Offers higher loan limits and lower interest rates than typical commercial home loans.
nepaliSummary: EPF घर सापटीले सदस्यहरूलाई घर किन्न, बनाउन वा खरिद गर्न आफ्नो कोष धितो राखेर ऋण लिन सक्षम बनाउँछ। व्यावसायिक घर ऋणभन्दा बढी रकम र कम ब्याजदरमा ऋण पाइन्छ।
benefits: Higher loan ceiling than special loan
eligibility: Active EPF member for minimum 3 years
Must not already own a house (first home preference)
loanLimit: Up to NPR 60 lakhs or 90% of fund balance (whichever is lower)

title: Education Loan
summary: EPF Education Loan helps members fund higher education for themselves or their dependent children. Covers tuition, living expenses, and study materials at recognized institutions inside and outside Nepal.
nepaliSummary: EPF शैक्षिक सापटीले सदस्यहरू वा उनीहरूका आश्रित सन्तानको उच्च शिक्षाको लागि रकम जुटाउन मद्दत गर्छ। नेपाल वा विदेशमा मान्यताप्राप्त शिक्षण संस्थामा पढ्न ट्युशन, बसोबास र पुस्तकहरूको खर्च समेट्छ।
eligibility: Active EPF member for minimum 1 year
Admission letter from recognized institution required
For dependent children: proof of relationship
loanLimit: Up to NPR 30 lakhs or 90% of fund balance (whichever is lower)

title: Easy Loan
summary: EPF Easy Loan is a simplified, fast-processing loan for immediate personal needs. Requires minimal documentation and is processed quickly compared to other EPF loan types.
nepaliSummary: EPF सहज सापटी तत्काल व्यक्तिगत आवश्यकताको लागि सरलीकृत, छिटो प्रशोधन हुने ऋण हो। अन्य EPF ऋण प्रकारहरूको तुलनामा कम कागजात र छिटो प्रक्रिया चाहिन्छ।
loanLimit: Up to 50% of accumulated fund balance

title: House Maintenance Loan
summary: EPF House Maintenance Loan provides funds specifically for repairing, renovating, or maintaining an existing home. Ideal for earthquake repair, renovation, or structural improvements.
nepaliSummary: EPF घर मर्मत सापटी विशेष गरी भइरहेको घरको मर्मत, नवीकरण वा रखरखावको लागि रकम प्रदान गर्छ। भूकम्प मर्मत, नवीकरण वा संरचनागत सुधारको लागि उपयुक्त।
eligibility: Active EPF member for minimum 2 years
Must own the property being repaired
loanLimit: Up to NPR 20 lakhs or 70% of fund balance (whichever is lower)

title: Land Purchase Loan
summary: EPF Land Purchase Loan allows members to finance the purchase of land for residential purposes using their provident fund as collateral. Enables home ownership by first securing land.
nepaliSummary: EPF जग्गा खरिद सापटीले सदस्यहरूलाई आवासीय प्रयोजनको लागि जग्गा खरिद गर्न आफ्नो सञ्चय कोष धितो राखेर वित्तीय सहायता लिन दिन्छ। पहिले जग्गा सुरक्षित गरेर घर स्वामित्व सक्षम बनाउँछ।
eligibility: Active EPF member for minimum 3 years
Land must be within Municipality or Sub-Metropolitan area
loanLimit: Up to NPR 40 lakhs or 80% of fund balance (whichever is lower)

title: Maternity and Child Care
summary: EPF Maternity Benefit provides financial support to female members during pregnancy and childbirth. Covers maternity leave pay and child care allowance for the first two children.
nepaliSummary: EPF मातृत्व सुविधाले महिला सदस्यहरूलाई गर्भावस्था र प्रसवको समयमा आर्थिक सहायता प्रदान गर्छ। पहिलो दुई सन्तानको लागि प्रसूति बिदा पारिश्रमिक र शिशु स्याहार भत्ता समेट्छ।
eligibility: Applicable for first two children only
Must submit within 90 days of birth

title: Funeral Grants
summary: EPF Funeral Grant provides a one-time lump sum payment to the family of a deceased EPF member to cover funeral and last rites expenses. Eases financial burden on bereaved families.
nepaliSummary: EPF अन्तिम संस्कार अनुदानले मृत्यु भएको EPF सदस्यको परिवारलाई अन्तिम संस्कार र अन्तिम क्रियाकलापको खर्च धान्न एकमुष्ट रकम प्रदान गर्छ। शोकसन्तप्त परिवारको आर्थिक बोझ कम गर्छ।
eligibility: Claimant must be legal heir or nominated family member
Deceased must have been active EPF member
Claim must be filed within 1 year of death

title: Accident Compensation Scheme
summary: EPF Accident Compensation provides financial support to members who suffer workplace or non-workplace accidents resulting in disability or injury. Covers medical costs and lost income during recovery.
nepaliSummary: EPF दुर्घटना क्षतिपूर्तिले कार्यस्थल वा कार्यस्थल बाहिरको दुर्घटनाबाट अपाङ्गता वा चोटपटक भएका सदस्यहरूलाई आर्थिक सहायता दिन्छ। उपचार खर्च र निको हुने अवधिको आम्दानी नोक्सानी समेट्छ।
eligibility: Active EPF member at time of accident
Accident must be reported within 30 days
Applicable for permanent and temporary disability

title: Healthcare Plan
summary: EPF Healthcare Plan provides medical expense reimbursement for EPF members and their immediate family. Covers hospitalization, surgery, and major illness treatment costs at empanelled hospitals.
nepaliSummary: EPF स्वास्थ्य उपचार योजनाले EPF सदस्यहरू र उनीहरूका नजिकका परिवारको चिकित्सा खर्च प्रतिपूर्ति गर्छ। सूचीकृत अस्पतालहरूमा अस्पताल भर्ना, शल्यक्रिया र गम्भीर बिरामीको उपचार खर्च समेट्छ।
eligibility: Treatment must be at empanelled/recognized hospital
Claim must be filed within 90 days of treatment
Family members: spouse and dependent children
Major illness and hospitalization only (not OPD for minor issues)
